keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Manchester United 0, Roma 1. Matías Soulé (Roma) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Rodrigo Mora.
Goal! Manchester United 0, Roma 2. Donyell Malen (Roma) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Matías Soulé (Roma) is shown the yellow card.
Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Devyne Rensch (Roma).
Substitution, Roma. Emanuele Lulli replaces Devyne Rensch because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Emanuele Lulli (Roma) is shown the yellow card for handball.
Donyell Malen (Roma) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Roma. Niccolò Pisilli replaces Rodrigo Mora.
Delay in match because of an injury Carlos Baleba (Manchester United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Manchester United. Youri Tielemans replaces Carlos Baleba because of an injury.
Goal! Manchester United 1, Roma 2. Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the high centre of the goal.
Ayden Heaven (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Manchester United. Lisandro Martínez replaces Ayden Heaven.
Substitution, Manchester United. Shea Lacey replaces Amad Diallo.
Substitution, Roma. Daniele Ghilardi replaces Gianluca Mancini.
Substitution, Roma. Evan Ndicka replaces Mario Hermoso.
Substitution, Roma. Santiago Castro replaces Donyell Malen.
Harry Maguire (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Manchester United 2, Roma 2. Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) right footed shot from the centre of the box.
